_comment: Golden vectors for THE sizing rule (plan 5.1, spec.distribute).
This formula exists twice: app/models/spec.py distribute() validates on
the server, and the TypeScript solver re-runs it live in the browser
during a drag (plan 7). Two implementations of one rule is the exact
kind of duplication that produced build-1 bug 3.5, so both are pinned
to this file. If you change the formula, change both and add a vector.
children: size = fixed extent, flex = share of the remainder, null flex
means 1.0. Sizes are cm, rounded to 4 decimals.

cases.name: two equal flex split what is left
repeating decimal is rounded to 4 places
fixed siblings leave nothing for flex
oversubscribed fixed clamps flex at zero, never negative
single flex child takes the whole extent
